title: Pasted geometric fibre maps agree with derived restriction
statement: Let X′→X over T→S be a cartesian square with vertical maps f′ and f. Let t:Spec Ω→T be any geometric point and K a bounded-below complex of abelian etale sheaves on X. Starting with derived global sections of g⁻¹Rf_*K, apply its derived global germ, the inverse-image stalk comparison, the outer-square fibre map, and inverse-image composition. This equals RΓ of exchange for the first square, followed by Leray for f′ and restriction along X′_t→X′. No strict-local or degree-zero hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 0GJ2 (specialization and Remark alternative-sp), 03Q9, 03QO and 0GJV (proof of lemma-specialization-cospecialization)

proof.text: Apply horizontal pasting to the two exchange squares. This factors the outer exchange through the pullback of the first exchange and the geometric-point exchange. Natural inverse-image stalk comparisons identify the sources and the inverse-image composition factors on the target.

Naturality of the derived global germ moves the first exchange past the germ. The derived global-germ/exchange identity for the geometric-point square identifies the remaining map with the derived unit and Leray, followed by the identity-point germ. That germ is invertible and cancels its inverse in the fibre-map definition, leaving exactly derived restriction.

theorem derivedFiberMap_restriction
    {X X' S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ T)
    (g : T ⟶ S) (p : X' ⟶ X) (sq : IsPullback p f' f g)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ T)
    (K : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) :
    (derivedGlobalGermAt t).app
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
          ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj K)) ≫
      (derivedPullbackStalkIso g t).hom.app
        ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj K) ≫
      etaleDerivedFiberMap
        ((IsPullback.of_hasPullback f' t).paste_horiz sq).toCommSq K ≫
      (Sheaf.Γ (pullback f' t).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map
        ((upperStarCompDerivedPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.fst f' t) p).hom.app K) =
    (Sheaf.Γ T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map
        ((derivedBaseChangeMapPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} sq.toCommSq).app K) ≫
      (etaleLerayPlus f').hom.app _ ≫
      etaleDerivedRestriction (pullback.fst f' t)
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} p).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)
